metric_definition.candidate_seed_rmsd: C-alpha RMSD after global Kabsch alignment
metric_definition.self_variability_baseline: max(median WT self-RMSD, median seed self-RMSD, median candidate self-RMSD)
metric_definition.excess_over_self_baseline: median candidate-seed RMSD minus self-variability baseline
metric_definition.design_position_displacement: mean C-alpha displacement at seed-to-candidate changed positions after global alignment

interpretation: This is a cross-model structural consistency / plausibility analysis. It is not experimental validation and does not impose a hard RMSD rejection threshold.
